why: The registered turbo image-to-video graph is hard-wired to 576x1024. Its ResolutionSelector node is not what the H3 node reads - setting the selector to 16:9 and running it still returned a portrait clip - so the width and height on MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo itself are what decide the frame, and they are set to the landscape delivery here.

measured.probe: one 124-frame clip from an approved Mello still
measured.notes: The character kept its body, face, scarf, backpack and limbs for the whole clip, which image-to-video had destroyed on the ink stick figure. It ignored every instruction about what not to do - told to stay seated it stood up and walked - so motion has to be written as what happens, never as what must not.
